name: CARD PLAYER 1
note: The silver-haired one who thinks he is the sharpest man at the table. Moved right off the piano: at 695,522 he stood at its right end, inside the piano's own rect, and the piano's whole comedy is that nobody is at it. He now stands at the card table's left corner, 45 px clear of the instrument.
poseNote: SEATED in the second chair on the table's left, leaning BACK with his cards close to his chest, chin up. Pleased with himself. MOVED OFF THE OUTERMOST CHAIR, which stands in front of the piano: he read as a card player to the eye but the piano-exclusion test could not tell the difference, and a rule that only holds when you squint is not a rule. That chair is now the empty fifth place.

sprite.note: PHASE 2A: one frame, and that is the phase, not an omission. Static staging first, and Tyler accepts the face in the room before any life is animated on it -- doc 36 Q128. The sheet is pre-scaled to the height this room asks for where the character stands, so the engine draws it at about 1:1 instead of shrinking a 1200 px painting on every frame.

barksNote: NONE. These nine are the room's population, not its dialogue: doc 07's reputation barks belong to the named ambient cast, and nothing in Tyler's Phase 2A ruling gives a generic patron a line. No written content is invented for them here or anywhere.
